framing.lineOfInquiry: Balwinder Kumar (P00174) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE036
framing.alternate: Balwinder Kumar (P00174) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: The location records are unreliable
alternateHypotheses.statement: Balwinder Kumar's location records are imprecise or inconsistent (tower-level accuracy, cloned or shared SIM), so they do not reliably place them at the scene.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: The record placing them near the scene (CDR) is only accurate to about 1.5 km

alternateHypotheses.test: Request a tower dump and the handset's GPS logs; check for SIM cloning; rely on high-accuracy fixes only.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Balwinder Kumar's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: In contact with Sunita Bhatia since 2025-05-01, 25 days before the incident (5 calls, 5 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Ajay Kapoor since 2025-05-02, 24 days before the incident (3 calls, 2 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Mukesh Saini since 2025-05-03, 23 days before the incident (8 calls, 5 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Balwinder Kumar was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded in the FIR as witness, not as accused
FIR text contains: '…no role has been attributed…'

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternatesConsideredNotSupported.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason

comparison.verdict: Every supporting item could be explained by at least one alternate, although the line of inquiry is stronger on weight (0.79 vs 0.55). Test the alternates before relying on it.

note: Each hypothesis is tested from both sides to reduce confirmation bias. Confidence scores are evidential balance (not probability of guilt). Human review is required.
